tools.name: get_net_worth
tools.description: What the household is worth, at the width you ask for: scope='estate' (default) is AUM plus real assets minus liabilities; 'aum' is investable securities and cash only; 'allocation' breaks that book down by asset class. FX-converted.

tools.name: get_exposure_to
tools.description: How much of the book sits behind a country (ISO-2) or a TRBC sector, with the positions behind it. Omit `value` for the ranked breakdown. Always read coverage.classified_pct — sector resolves for only part of the book.

tools.name: list_households
tools.description: The households this user belongs to, with their ids. Needed only when they belong to more than one — otherwise omit household_id and it resolves to theirs.

tools.name: get_portfolio_positions
tools.description: Positions for a household, paginated, sorted by market value.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: Accounts and custody for the household.

tools.name: get_risk
tools.description: Risk for the household, or for one portfolio. Omit portfolio_id for the household-wide dashboard — volatility, VaR, concentration, drawdown.

tools.name: get_portfolio_drift
tools.description: Drift of a portfolio versus its target allocation.

tools.name: list_facilities
tools.description: Credit facilities — balances, limits, rates, maturities, covenants, collateral.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: One credit facility in full, including covenant headroom and pledged collateral.

tools.name: list_real_assets
tools.description: Real assets — property, vessels, aircraft, art and collections.

tools.name: get_real_asset
tools.description: One real asset in detail.

tools.name: get_real_asset_economics
tools.description: Real-asset economics — income, costs, net cashflow and net yield.

tools.name: get_brief
tools.description: Today's read on markets. kind='market' is the signal-derived pulse; kind='editorial' is the brief the desk authored — regime, themes, risks.

tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Market data for the user's watchlist, with signals where available.

tools.name: list_published_content
tools.description: Antevo's newest published videos, podcasts and research notes.

tools.name: lookup_index_by_brand
tools.description: Find alt-asset indices by brand or keyword (wine, watches, art, cars).

tools.name: get_recent_results
tools.description: Recent auction-realised and list-price events over a look-back window.

tools.name: get_signals_recent
tools.description: Recent alt-asset trade signals over a look-back window (days_back).

tools.name: get_correlations
tools.description: Cross-asset correlations by effect type.

tools.name: get_equity_fundamentals
tools.description: Equity fundamentals — financials, growth, margins, valuation (P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield, ROIC), peers.

tools.name: run_technical_analysis
tools.description: Technical analysis for any instrument — how indicators lean, the regime, or a full backtest.

tools.name: list_layers
tools.description: Catalogue of geopolitical map layers you can request.

tools.name: get_geo_map
tools.description: Global geopolitical intelligence layers over a look-back window.

tools.name: get_country_brief
tools.description: Per-country geopolitical drilldown (ISO-2).

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description: The household's tracked instruments with price, momentum, how each leans and volatility.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: Financial goals — target vs current funding, progress, gap and status.

tools.name: get_today_brief
tools.description: The household's daily briefing — what matters today.

tools.name: get_unread_alerts
tools.description: Unread alerts for the household.

tools.name: get_open_breaches
tools.description: Open compliance/policy breaches.

tools.name: get_drift_snapshot
tools.description: Drift snapshot across the household's portfolios.

tools.name: get_upcoming_calendar
tools.description: Upcoming dividends, earnings and macro events that touch the book.

tools.name: list_family
tools.description: Household entities — people and structures.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: One household entity in detail.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Document metadata in the household vault.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Metadata for one document.

tools.description: Record a holding the user already owns: a security (ISIN preferred; an exact ticker or a name also works) and a quantity, in one of their portfolios. Never buys or sells.
